title: alaternus pumilus
intro: Alaternus pumilus, commonly known as Sumac, is a small evergreen shrub native to the Mediterranean region. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating various digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alaternus pumilus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exert antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
